object.definition: There are $n$ fixed unknown differentiable real-valued components $f_i$, with aggregate payoff $f=n^{-1}\sum_i f_i$. The algorithm selects the component index for every query.

assumption.description: The set $Y\subset\mathbb R^{d_y}$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex. Assume $\operatorname{diam}(Y)\le D_Y$ and $x\in\mathbb R^{d_x}$. Each $f_i$ is continuously differentiable on a neighborhood of the product domain.
